new_destination_note: Two new destinations proposed for the owner (Methven, Twizel); their spots are placed as standalone with proposed_destination set so none is lost if the proposals are declined. Fairlie, Mount Dobson and Ski Roundhill are too thin a cluster to propose (Fox Peak is only in review); Fairlie stays a standalone town spot. Waipara Valley, Peel Forest Park, Little River Rail Trail, Mount Sunday and Lake Coleridge are outside every span. Existing destinations needed no span change.
